name: ☆Support Pregnancy School☆
source: In order to make the small town prosper again, you were forced to transfer to a school called "Private Aid Pregnancy Academy". He is not tall, but…………………… Find props to break pussies, level up and complete pregnancy tasks for all members. Or, with the help of some people, escape from the school... Allocate resources rationally and start the next generation open world campus RPG!
translation: 为了让小镇再次繁荣，你被迫转学到一所名为“私人援助怀孕学院”的学校。他个子不高，但是……………………找到破阴的道具，升级，为所有成员完成怀孕任务。或者，在一些人的帮助下，逃离学校……合理分配资源，开启次世代开放世界校园RPG！
